description: Turns a stereo pair into a mid and a side signal, and turns a mid and side pair back into stereo, in two separate halves that can be used on their own

inputs.text: The left channel going into the encoder
The right channel going into the encoder
The mid signal going into the decoder
The side signal going into the decoder

outputs.text: The mid input plus the side input, giving the left channel back
The mid input minus the side input, giving the right channel back
Half the sum of the left and right inputs, which is what the two channels have in common
Half the difference between the left and right inputs, which is what only one of them carries
